steps.content: Though weak, the shackles' momentary restraint on "Miles" is all you need. You shove away, clutching the generator, and swim upward. But the iron box is an anchor, dragging you down.
Your muscles scream, your kicks growing weak and uncoordinated. A pressure builds in your ears—the warning of oxygen depletion.
Light above! Almost there!
You tug the lifeline and surge upward, but after a few meters, your body betrays you, ceasing to move entirely...
A wave of blackness swallows your sight.
[Ringing Ears, Dizziness]
The warnings of prolonged hunger and blood loss—ignored for too long—choose this precise moment to crash over you.
Mmph!
Unable to call for help underwater, you pull the rope blindly, desperation overriding thought.
The sound of disturbed water closes in on you. Is it "Miles"? Other awakened monsters? You don't dare look. Any unnecessary movement now could cost you your life.
Your lungs are on fire. Consciousness flickers... Finally, the movement stops right beside you. Something coils around your waist.
You thrash to break free, but the grip only tightens, immobilizing you. It even starts wrestling for the iron box!
You drive an elbow back with your last strength, but it shows no sign of loosening its grip. As your fingers scramble to pry the thing off, they brush against the "monster"—and you freeze.

In that moment of shock, an air tube is thrust into your mouth. Air floods your lungs. The "thing" around your waist tightens, not as a restraint, but as a rescue, pulling you swiftly toward the surface.
The moment your head breaks through, you spit out the tube and gasp a question.
Ceto? Is that you?

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Who else would it be? A ghost?
I can't see a thing.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: It happens. We're still some distance from shore. Keep your voice down. Don't attract them.
The thing chasing me... I think it might be Miles.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: ...I know.

Silence falls between you as Ceto swims for shore at full speed, clutching you with one arm and the metal box with the other. But the Tide Crawlers are faster. You feel the water churn violently beneath you.
After a desperate distance, Ceto halts abruptly. Her hands work quickly, untying the lifeline from your waist and fastening it securely around her own.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Listen. You're just oxygen-starved, and weak. Your sight will come back. When it does, pull me up. I need to keep these things contained in the water. Can't let them reach the shore.
What are you going to do?

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Enough questions. Take that damn box and get to shore. Now!

Before you can protest, she hurls you toward the shore like a sack of stones. You land hard on solid ground. Instantly, your blindness amplifies the chaos: a chorus of monstrous hisses, the sharp shing of a dagger being drawn.

The world narrows to sound and smell. The wet thwack of steel meeting rotten flesh. The rip of fabric. The overwhelming putrid stench of the creatures. And the low, resonant hum of Mania echoing through the shackles' connection.

steps.speaker: Rancors
steps.content: Are you cutting him open? Go on, look at it. Look at what spills out. ...Miles is long gone. He's mine now. Let him go. Let yourself go... Turning your blade on your own comrade? Is this how you protect everyone... you, the last hope of the lighthouse keepers? Trash, worthless... why are you the only one still alive... living like a pathetic coward...
[White Flash] [Coast]

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Now!
You haul on the rope just as Ceto disengages. Her blade sweeps through the Black Tide with terrifying force—
[Battle CG]
And the horde recoils. The twisted shadows, cowed by the power radiating from her steel, fall back to circle at a wary distance. She is moments from breaking the surface...
When a slender tendril, blacker than the deepest shadow, lashes out from a blind spot.
Watch out!
Monstrous claws rake across her back, sending a spray of blood into the water. She doesn't even blink.
In one fluid motion, she pivots. A frigid arc of steel flashes in a devastating backhand strike, cleaving her ambusher cleanly in two.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Pathetic lump of meat. You're not fit to be compared to Miles.

steps.speaker: Ceto
steps.content: Pull me up!
